snippet.title: Jupi Plays Indie Games: ALL THE GAMES [Game Jaaj 4] [Part 15]
snippet.description:
Basically I wanted to attempt to play all of the games that were entered in the Game Jaaj 4, so I did. This game jam seems to be in portragueese, so I really cannot understand much about it.
http://jams.gamejolt.io/gamejaaj4
